description: Default reusable probe-comparison driver verification on both supported Node majors.
execution: Shortened one-round checks on Node 26 then Node 24, then default six-round checks on Node 26 then Node 24; sequential and without concurrent builds/tests.
validation: Three distinct variants; every variant appears twice in every order position; all workload and magnitude controls pass; source hashes and median calculations verified.

reports.method: All six variant orders rotate; six rounds balance order. Fresh child per workload, five retained timing calls and two untimed exact-value controls. Shortened runs are smoke checks, not stable timing evidence.

measurement.sampleOrder: execution order; median computed from a sorted copy
measurement.exactControls: untimed analytic reciprocal equality and expected-plus-one inequality; normalized with independent Euclid; expected value supplied as assignment under default limits
measurement.timing: complete linear-analysis or explanation call; excludes fixture construction and assertions
measurement.rss: after workload and extra magnitude controls; not peak or incremental memory
measurement.memoryLimit: V8 old space only; not a total-process memory cap
